updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Admin Units Support for Copilot & Cowork
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is extending Administrative Units support to Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork, allowing organizations to delegate DLP policy management to unit-scoped administrators without granting tenant-wide permissions. This enables better compliance with regional and departmental governance boundaries while maintaining optional organization-wide policy application.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector – Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft Rights Management connector is transitioning from shared-secret to certificate-based authentication, requiring admins to configure their own Entra app registration and certificate via new PowerShell cmdlets. This change improves security posture but requires manual setup for certificate import, registry configuration, and workload-specific validation across Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI.

updates.title: 3 Elevation of Privilege Vulnerabilities Patched in Microsoft Office SharePoint
updates.summary: Three authorization-related vulnerabilities in SharePoint (CVE-2026-102861, CVE-2026-102862, CVE-2026-105720) allow authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network due to missing or incorrect authorization controls. Admins should apply patches promptly to prevent privilege escalation within SharePoint environments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-102865 Microsoft Office SharePoint Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in SharePoint permits authorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network due to flawed access controls. Organizations should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized data exposure through SharePoint.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Network Data Security Scope to All or Specific Websites
updates.summary: Admins can now scope Purview network data security DLP policies integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access to apply across all websites or exclude specific cloud apps, enabling protection for apps not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog. This extends DLP governance beyond pre-cataloged applications to broader web traffic.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Rule-Based Alert Auto-Resolution and Tagging
updates.summary: Organizations can now define rules to automatically resolve or tag DLP alerts based on custom business criteria, such as low-severity mail to trusted partners or alerts from specific departments. This reduces alert fatigue and improves triage efficiency by pre-filtering predictable alert patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – Apply Default SharePoint Library Labels to Data at Rest
updates.summary: Purview now supports auto-labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library, closing labeling gaps for data at rest without manual user intervention. This ensures consistent, secure-by-default protection across SharePoint libraries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Administrators can now include file archiving actions within Purview retention policies, moving inactive SharePoint content to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This extends data lifecycle management beyond keep/delete to include cost-optimized archival.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers – Compliance Report for Policy Changes
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers policy compliance report identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that fall out of compliance after policy changes. This helps admins track and remediate compliance gaps when updating organizational barriers.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security – General Availability with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Purview Network Data Security is now generally available, integrating with Entra Global Secure Access to protect text, files, and AI interactions at the network layer and enforce DLP policies against untrusted cloud applications. This provides defense-in-depth against data exfiltration through browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – Auto-Labeling for Legacy Office Files
updates.summary: Server-side auto-labeling now supports legacy Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive, allowing organizations to automatically apply sensitivity labels to older file types. This extends data classification coverage to legacy content that may not receive manual attention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – File Labeler and Viewer for macOS
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview's File Labeler and File Viewer applications are being brought to macOS, providing Mac users with the same data protection and labeling capabilities available on Windows. Advanced label-based protection features will be available in a phased rollout.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention Based on Last Accessed for Files
updates.summary: Organizations can now apply retention policies to SharePoint and OneDrive files based on last access date, enabling time-based cleanup of stale content. This helps admins optimize storage and compliance by automatically managing inactive files.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Reduce Temporary File Noise for Endpoint Activities
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management is addressing high-volume, low-signal temporary file events from Windows and applications by introducing enhanced exclusion patterns for temporary file naming conventions. This reduces alert noise while maintaining visibility into genuine insider risk indicators.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – AI-Powered Policy Sync and Device Health Investigation
updates.summary: An AI agent skill detects and alerts on unhealthy policy synchronization and device configuration issues in Endpoint DLP, enabling proactive remediation of compliance gaps. This improves visibility into endpoint DLP deployment health across the organization.
